documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive reported a strong first quarter for FY27, achieving its 11th consecutive quarter of robust performance with record quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management noted that consolidated revenue grew by 52.1% driven by strong underlying demand, despite volatility in aluminum alloy prices. The company also announced a revision in its full-year growth guidance to high-teens and increased its planned capex to around Rs. 700 crore due to new order wins requiring an immediate new plant in the South. ASK Automotive reported its Q1 FY27 financial results with consolidated revenue growing by 52.1% year-on-year to Rs.

guidance.claim: The company revised its full-year growth guidance to high-teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Management stated that capital expenditure for the year may reach around Rs. 700 crore.
guidance.quote: I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

guidance.claim: The company is confident that it will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remains robust and private consumption is resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the industry to benefit from improving consumer purchasing power and easier access to vehicle finance.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we believe the industry will continue to benefit from these far-reaching reforms, improving consumer purchasing power, and easier access to vehicle finance.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment and policy support.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labour reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: All OEM customers are carrying on with their original production schedules, which show a nice growth for the year.
demand_outlook.quote: As far outlook of the two-wheeler industry is concerned, our all our OEM customers they are carrying on with their original production schedules which shows a nice growth in this year also and none of the supplies have been affected by the raw materials or anything.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated a new plant will be set up urgently in Bangalore to cater to new orders.
capex_expansion.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will be investing around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

capex_expansion.claim: For FY27, the company will be spending about Rs. 400 Cr in capex.
capex_expansion.quote: FY27 we'll be spending about Rs. 400 Cr.

margins_costs.claim: With aluminum prices expected to remain benign, management anticipates an improvement in EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 12.0% for Q1 FY27.
The EBITDA margin was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices, and would have been higher by 80 basis points in Q4.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier. For this impact, EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 80 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The aim of the company is to sustain current level of EBITDA margins and improve gradually.
margins_costs.quote: Our aim is to sustain current level of EBITDA margins and continue our efforts to improve gradually in the subsequent quarters, depending upon the growth of the two-wheeler industry and geopolitical environment.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has confirmed alloy wheel orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: Karoli plant capacity utilization increased from 60%-65% to about 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates 18 state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities.
orders_capacity.quote: 18 State of the art Manufacturing Facilities

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Bengaluru plant has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is still at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to utilize internal accruals and take term loans for machines to fund the capex.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: Management remains confident that the debt-to-equity ratio will not exceed 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals and free cash will be ploughed back into the company while containing debt levels.
capital_allocation.quote: All these internal accruals free cash will be ploughed back in the company, so we will see to it even the debt levels are contained within the limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Important developments that could affect operations include changes in industry structure, political and economic environment in India and overseas, tax laws, import duties, litigation, and labour relations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Important developments that could affect the Company’s operations include changes in the industry structure, significant changes in political and economic environment in India and overseas, tax laws, import duties, litigation and labour relations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy and affected the Indian economy.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export revenue was affected by trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates and geopolitical tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to operationalize the new Bangalore plant before March in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to continue on the growth path on a sustainable basis for the full year.
management_commitments.quote: We have outperformed the industry growth and our aim is to continue on this growth path on a sustainable basis with clear focus on the bottom line to enhance the shareholder’s value.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Alloy wheel revenue for FY27 is expected to be around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
